strategy.subtitle: Choose how to select among multiple enabled global configs, and how failures are handled.
strategy.multiModelNote: When multiple global configs are enabled (by order), the following applies:
strategy.failureBehaviorFirst: First: Always use the first active config (lowest order). If that call fails, the request fails immediately — no automatic fallback to the next config.
strategy.failureBehaviorRoundRobin: Round-robin: Each new request uses the next config in order. If a call fails, that request fails; the next request will use the next config in the rotation.

resourceSettings.syncWorkersDesc: Platform-level global default. It controls the maximum number of concurrent workers each datasource sync task can use inside LensNode. It mainly affects Feishu folder scanning, file downloads, and conversion preparation; Git sync is usually affected less. Higher values may improve sync speed, but increase Feishu API requests, local CPU/memory usage, and model conversion pressure.

datasourceWizard.documentModelTooltip: Datasource-level override for the default document model. It is intended for future complex document understanding, structure enhancement, and model-based conversion. MarkItDown text extraction does not call it today.

datasourceWizard.visionModelTooltip: Datasource-level override for the default vision model. It affects standalone images, embedded document images, and PDF visual recognition.
datasourceWizard.convertEmbeddedImagesHint: Requires document extraction. Describes images embedded in Office/PDF documents.
datasourceWizard.pdfAdvancedHint: PDF image recognition calls the vision model. By default it only complements weak-text/scanned pages to avoid indexing meaningless logos and icons.
datasourceWizard.pdfExtractImagesHint: Only controls image recognition inside PDF files. By default, it prioritizes larger images on scanned or image-based pages, then filters and compresses them before description.
datasourceWizard.pdfExtractImagesOnTextPages: Recognize images on normal PDF text pages
datasourceWizard.pdfExtractImagesOnTextPagesHint: Off by default. When enabled, pages that already have extractable text are still checked for images. Use this for documents with diagrams or flowcharts; it can increase cost and may describe logos, icons, or unrelated decorative images.
datasourceWizard.pdfRenderScannedPagesHint: When enabled, PDF pages without extractable text are sent to the vision model as rendered page images. Confirm the cost is acceptable.
datasourceWizard.pdfMaxPagesTooltip: Only limits PDF advanced recognition pages. It does not affect normal document text extraction.
datasourceWizard.pdfMaxImagesPerPageTooltip: Limits how many embedded images can be described per PDF page to avoid excessive calls on image-heavy pages.
datasourceWizard.pdfRenderDpiTooltip: Resolution for rendering scanned pages. Higher values are clearer but produce larger images and higher cost.
datasourceWizard.pdfMinTextCharsTooltip: Unit is characters. For example, 30 means that if a page has fewer than 30 directly extractable characters, SourceLens treats it as a possible scanned or image-based page. If full scanned-page recognition is enabled, the page is then recognized with the vision model.
datasourceWizard.pdfMinImageAreaRatioTooltip: Enter a page area ratio from 0 to 1, not pixels. For example, 0.08 means about 8%; images smaller than 8% of the page are skipped to filter logos, icons, and decorative images.
datasourceWizard.conversionLimitsHint: Keep conversion bounded for large files and image-heavy datasources.
datasourceWizard.globalConversionLimitsHint: Bound all conversion inputs. PDF-specific page and image-density limits are configured under PDF advanced recognition.
datasourceWizard.maxFileSizeTooltip: Source files larger than this value are skipped by conversion to avoid slowing down sync tasks.
datasourceWizard.maxImagesTooltip: Limits the total number of images described in one task, including standalone images and embedded document images.

wizard.contextHint: Write what the model cannot infer from reading code alone: business background, team conventions, search priorities, and directories to avoid.
wizard.contextPlaceholder:
# Information the model can't know just from reading code — write it here.

## Project overview
# SourceLens is a self-hosted AI code Q&A platform.
# backend/ is the Django REST API; lensnode/ is a separately deployed execution node
# that runs Deep Agents and pushes results back to the main service via WebSocket.
# frontend/ is the Vue 3 admin console; it only talks to backend/ REST APIs.

## Search priorities
# Business logic lives in backend/lens/. backend/agentcore/ is a git submodule — don't look for business code there.
# Frontend pages: frontend/src/pages/lens/. Admin components: frontend/src/admin/.
# Agent behavior: lensnode/lensnode/agent_runtime.py.

## Avoid misreading
# references/ contains reference documents, not source code — don't analyze it as code.
# For current field structure, read the latest migration only, not historical ones.
